retriever.candidateRule: at least one analyzed term; retain score > 0

metrics.ideal: sort all qrels by grade descending, not just retrieved IDs
metrics.macro: unweighted query means; answerable metrics and all-query precision separately; no null to zero coercion

purpose: One actual in-process BM25 search per query, four cutoff evaluations; no tuning or model generation.
testPolicy: No edits to original corpus,queries,gold; public authored collection, not blind. No configuration search over test. Future generator pair and inputs fixed in comparison-plan.v1.json before this capture.
